title: Cad, Coda, Animate, Compose Algorithm Storybook Stories
description: Populate four Storybook scope directories already registered in .storybook/scopes.ts (part of the parallel workforce under parent ticket FEATURE-COMPLETE-COMPOSABLE-STORYBOOK-COVERING-THE-MONOREPO, issue #2123): cad (InteractionCanvas/InteractionSpatialView box interaction demo, pure-JS R3FPreviewKernel-style stub kernel, no cad wasm), coda (OntologyTree/ValidationTree variant coverage gap-check vs existing .storybook/stories/ui/ stories), animate (PresentationDeck reveal.js-based deck renderer with an inline 2-3 slide fixture), and compose/algorithm gap-fill (cross-check compose/dev/algorithm/js/index.ts exports against the 8 existing story files, only add if a genuine uncovered hook family exists). Verify each scope boots via bun ./script.ts dev storybook <scope-id> and add a playwright spec per new workstream file.
summary:
Added Storybook stories for 3 of the 4 target scopes; compose/algorithm needed no new file (genuine gap-check found full coverage already).

cad (.storybook/stories/cad/Renderer.stories.tsx): InteractionCanvas/InteractionSpatialView hosting the real primitive.box interaction (cad/asset/modelDefinition/spatial.shape/interaction/box.json) via loadSpatialInteraction. Verified cad/plugin/rs has no pkg/ (no real wasm). Built a story-local StoryBoxKernel that Object.assign-copies every preview-math method off r3fPreviewKernel (R3FPreviewKernel extends PreciseSpatialKernelMath, confirmed these are class-field own-properties so the copy works) and only hand-implements createBoxFromCorners/createBoxFromCornersDiff/volume/tessellate — the same pattern cad/core/js/index.ts's own "RecordingStubKernel" test uses. Idle story shows the fresh ground-pick plane; CommittedBox scripts corner→corner→height→confirm on mount (same coordinates as the passing core test) producing a real committed box mesh via useTessellation and a hand-authored double-sided box MeshTransfer.

coda (.storybook/stories/coda/CodaTrees.stories.tsx + CodaValidationTree.stories.tsx — two files since a CSF file allows only one default-exported meta): read the existing .storybook/stories/ui/OntologyTree.stories.tsx and ValidationTree.stories.tsx first. Found real gaps — OntologyNodeKind has 13 members, existing stories only exercise 7 (And/Or/Not/SomeValuesFrom/ExactCardinality/DataSomeValuesFrom/Class); AllValuesFrom/MinCardinality/MaxCardinality/DataAllValuesFrom/DataHasValue/DatatypeRestriction were untouched, and hasValidationCardinalityBadge's n/n chip was only ever shown for ExactCardinality, never Min/Max. Added one OntologyTree story and one ValidationTree story covering exactly those 6 kinds (a Wohnung/residential-unit fixture) with real truth-value evaluation.

animate (.storybook/stories/animate/PresentationDeck.stories.tsx): PresentationDeck from animate/present/renderer/react/index.tsx. Confirmed reveal.js's structural CSS is already imported by the component module itself (import \"reveal.js/dist/reveal.css\"); the --r-* theming lives in a separate ./globals.css package export not pulled in anywhere else (mirrors the real mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage usage), so imported it explicitly via @semio-tech/animate-present-renderer-react/globals.css. Built a minimal 3-slide Presentation (Chapter→Sequence→Thought→Slide tree, plain text embodiments, auto document-flow layout since no dispositions declare a position).

compose/algorithm: read compose/dev/algorithm/js/index.ts's full export surface and cross-checked every hook/helper against the 8 existing story files (Cluster, CopyAndPaste, Delete, Drag, FindReplaceableTypesInDesigns, Flatten, KitStore, Move). Every exported hook family is already exercised (useFlatDesignPreview, useFlattenPreview, useCopyPastePreview, deletePieces, dragPieces, movePieces, findReplaceableTypesForSelection, kitSurface). The only unexercised symbols (loadFlatDesignBundle, flattenDiagramLayoutDiff, useAlgorithmPieceSelection, copyDesign, pasteDesign, getKitPorts, createIpoAlgorithmLayout) are internal implementation details already invoked transitively through the covered hooks — not a distinct uncovered family. Added no file, per the ticket's own guidance to skip rather than pad with redundant coverage.

Verification: booted each scope in isolation (bun ./script.ts dev storybook <scope>) on free ports after several collisions with other concurrent agent sessions' dev servers in the 6020-6099 range; confirmed index.json lists the new story ids with zero missing-story warnings, and curled iframe.html for every new story id (200 status): 📐cad--idle, 📐cad--committed-box, 🧠coda-ontologytree--uncovered-kinds, 🧠coda-validationtree--uncovered-kinds, 🎬animate--three-slide-deck. A pre-existing, unrelated Vite pre-bundle warning about @semio-tech/compose-rs-wasm (from the shared .storybook/preview.tsx WASM_LOADERS registry, reachable regardless of active scope) appeared in every scope's log — not caused by these changes. The sandboxed Claude Browser tool could not reach localhost in this environment, so full client-side console-error verification wasn't possible; relied on the documented curl+log bar instead.

Playwright specs added per the task's own convention (.storybook/cad-renderer.spec.ts, .storybook/coda-trees.spec.ts, .storybook/animate-presentation-deck.spec.ts), modeled on .storybook/puzzle-2d.spec.ts. Note: .storybook/playwright.config.ts's testMatch still only lists puzzle-2d.spec.ts and is outside the allowed edit scope for this ticket, so these new specs aren't wired into the default `bunx playwright test` run yet — a follow-up for whoever owns playwright.config.ts (or pass the file path explicitly to playwright test to run them ad hoc).
